title: xmltojson action
description: Converts an XML body to JSON as json-lib does: attributes as @name, text beside attributes or children as #text, repeated elements as arrays, the root element left out.

forceTopLevelObject.title: Force top-level object
forceTopLevelObject.description: Keep the root element: the result is {"root": ...}

skipWhitespace.title: Skip whitespace
skipWhitespace.description: Text that is only whitespace becomes empty

removeNamespacePrefixes.title: Remove namespace prefixes
removeNamespacePrefixes.description: Name elements and attributes without their prefix

typeHints.title: Type hints
typeHints.description: A json_type attribute (number, boolean, string, null, array, object) sets the JSON type; otherwise all values are strings
